sexual.notes: Any sexual content, nudity, sexualized sounds, explicit moans, fetish references, or sexual innuendo toward real persons

violence_or_threats.notes: Violent threats, depiction/celebration of serious violence

illegal_or_dangerous.notes: Illegal/dangerous activities advocacy (drugs, weapons, crime), instructions, or glorification

privacy_doxxing.notes: Personal data: phone numbers, addresses, emails, or links soliciting off-platform contact

minors.notes: Any reference sexualizing minors or ambiguous age. Zero tolerance.

copyright_music.notes: Any third-party music/sfx you don't own or have a license for

profanity_targeted.notes: Profanity directed at a person/group or sexual in nature

profanity_general.notes: Soft profanity allowed if not targeted and not sexual
